gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP039 kit's 600 W arrives as one folding panel with an MC4 output at 44 V and an MC4-to-XT60 cable plus a 1.5 m MC4 extension in the panel's box, while BLUETTI's Apex 300 + 3× 200 W listing shows no solar cable in the station's box list and ships each unit separately.
standout_why: Compared against StormWatts (cited), OutageReady and Dealectric's two kit pages. StormWatts has no ALLPOWERS 600 W kit, names included cables for only one kit (Anker C2000 Gen 2), and gives no voltage or current for the Apex 300 or the EcoFlow DELTA 3800 Gen4. OutageReady has no 600 W kit and only general wiring advice. Dealectric's under-$3,000 page lists the R3500 + SP039 but states no connector, cable or panel voltage for it; it already carries the strongest finding of this kind (Elite 400 + 2× 350 W is parallel-only, capped under 660 W, Y-branch cable not in the box). So the cable-and-connector half is new, but I could not open a maker document for the station-side input window (volts and amps) of the R3500, P1800, R2500 V2 or Apex 300, so the compatibility table is half-filled.
decides: It confirms rather than changes the pick. Among kits with 600 W or more in the box, the R3500 + SP039 (ships now, $1,753.93 link price, $1,993.10 store) is the one where the maker's listing shows a single panel, a single MC4 lead and the adapter cable included. The BLUETTI 3× 200 W and 2× 350 W kits need a wiring decision and are pre-orders. The P1800 + 600 W kit ($718.20 link price, ships now) stays the budget row, but its station's solar input cap is unsourced, so the page should not claim it uses the full 600 W.

findings.label: Output connector and voltage as the maker lists them
findings.note: Read from the store's own listing text for this product through storecheck search; the product page itself returned HTTP 429 on every attempt. The listing does not say whether 44 V is working or open-circuit voltage. Arithmetic: 600 W / 44 V = 13.6 A at rated output if 44 V is the working voltage.
